Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez criticizes leftist governments and congratulates Flavio Bolsonaro
U.S. Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez addressed alleged illicit funding for leftist parties in Latin America via Twitter on October 6, while also congratulating Flavio Bolsonaro for his electoral victory in Brazil's first round vote.
Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez, a U.S. Congressman representing Florida’s 28th district since 2021, made several statements on his official Twitter account on October 6, 2026, addressing political developments in Latin America and expressing support for Brazilian politician Flavio Bolsonaro.
Later that afternoon at 16:32 UTC, Gimenez congratulated Flavio Bolsonaro on his electoral success in Brazil's first round of voting and criticized current leftist policies in the region. He stated, " | Parabéns ao meu amigo @FlavioBolsonaro pela grande vitória no primeiro turno! O Brasil está cansado de Lula, da esquerda e de políticas que fortalecem ditaduras como Cuba e Venezuela. A família Bolsonaro tem sido uma grande parceira dos Estados Unidos e uma voz firme https://t.co/6fR7d5h7Ua".
Gimenez’s remarks come amid ongoing debates about foreign influence and funding in Latin American politics. The Forum of São Paulo is an organization that brings together left-wing parties from across Latin America and has been accused by some critics of receiving illicit funding from Venezuela to support socialist candidates.
Gimenez was born in Havana, Cuba in 1954 and currently resides in Miami. He graduated from Barry University with a Bachelor of Public Administration degree in 1999 and previously served both in the Florida House of Representatives and the Miami-Dade County Commission before being elected to Congress.
